lessonTitle: How Do Plants Survive in Different Environments?
title: The Rainforest Cast

badge.name: Green Lens

hook.look: This is a scout photo of the place for our film. The cast is everyone who stars in it.
hook.head: Scene 18 · The Rainforest Cast
hook.alt: Thick green rainforest treetops with mist on the hills behind
hook.cap: Daintree Rainforest, Australia, today. The treetops block much of the sunlight.
hook.note: So much rain, so little light! Which plants fit here?

opti.brief: Welcome to the rainforest, crew. Today we film Scene 18, The Rainforest Cast. Build four plants that fit here, then take the shot.
opti.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Cast one plant for each place. Then tell me what you think.

vr.look: A model is a copy of something real. A trait is a feature of a plant, like its leaf shape.

models.name: Fern
models.alt: Bright green ferns with wide, feathery leaves

models.name: Bromeliad Plant
models.alt: Red bromeliad seen from above, with water held in the cup of its leaves
models.trait: Leaves make a cup for rain.

models.name: Liana Vine
models.alt: Thick, woody vine looping up from the forest floor into the trees

models.name: Passion Flower
models.alt: Blue and white passion flower on a leafy vine with curly stems

steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Rainforest in Filter environments. Click Tropical Rainforest, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Set the Fern down low. Lift the Bromeliad Plant up high. Stand the Liana Vine tall, with the Passion Flower beside it.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The ___ has ___. That helps it in the rainforest because ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Make it rain on your cast: Rain Effect

vr.full: Your photo shows all 4 plants: Fern down low, Bromeliad Plant up high, Liana Vine and Passion Flower.

studio.title: Casting call

labels.done: All 4 parts are cast. Nice work, crew!

studio.look: A casting call is how a director picks who gets each part. Each place card shows a real place. Below it are 4 plants. A trait is a feature of a plant, like thick leaves or deep roots.
studio.do: Read the place card. Tap the plant that fits, or drag it onto the card. Then tap the trait that helps it there.

places.cup: 🥤 Leaves that hold rain like a cup
places.deep: ⬇️ Deep roots that reach water far down
places.spongy: 🧽 Spongy roots that grow in soaked soil

card.name: Desert
card.alt: Dry, rocky desert with a few small bushes
card.facts: Dry sand and rock. Very little rain falls here.

pairs.ok: Cast! Agave grows in dry deserts.
pairs.placeMiss: Look at the place again. It is very dry. Which trait helps there?

card.name: Rainforest
card.alt: Thick green rainforest plants growing close together
card.facts: Rain falls almost every day. Tall trees make deep shade.

pairs.ok: Cast! Bromeliads grow in rainy forests, often up on tree branches.
pairs.placeMiss: Look at the place again. Rain falls almost every day. Which trait uses that rain?

card.name: Prairie
card.alt: Wide, grassy prairie with yellow flowers under a big sky
card.facts: A wide, grassy land. The soil can dry out for weeks.

pairs.ok: Cast! The compass plant grows on sunny prairies.
pairs.placeMiss: Look at the place again. The top of the soil dries out. Where is the water?

card.name: Marsh
card.alt: Flat, wet marsh with reeds standing in shallow water
card.facts: A wetland. The soil is soaked with water.

pairs.ok: Cast! Cattails grow in marshes, with their roots under water.
pairs.placeMiss: Look at the place again. The soil is soaked. Which roots can grow there?

voice.brief: Welcome to the rainforest, crew. Today we film Scene 18, The Rainforest Cast. Build four plants that fit here, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your four plants. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Rainforest, and pick Tropical Rainforest. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Set the fern down low. Lift the bromeliad up high. Add the vine and the flower. Then tell me about one trait.
voice.extra: Got time? Make it rain on your plants. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Cast one plant for each place. Then tell me what you think.
